data.name: session_state
data.spec: Current authentication state for the header account area, fetched from GET /api/session when the home page loads. authenticated=false with username null means show the Register and Login links; authenticated=true shows the saved username as text plus the Sign out link. Refreshed to the unauthenticated value after a successful Sign out (DELETE /api/session).

data.name: nationality
data.spec: Currently selected nationality value in the registration "Nationality" combobox; empty string until the visitor picks "Vietnam". Sent to RegisterAccount as nationality.

data.name: name
data.spec: Current text of the registration "Name" textbox. Sent to RegisterAccount as name.

data.name: passport_number
data.spec: Current text of the registration "Passport number" textbox. Sent to RegisterAccount as passport_number.

data.name: passport_expiration_date
data.spec: Current value of the registration "Passport expiration date" date textbox, as an entered date string. Sent to RegisterAccount as passport_expiration_date.

data.name: date_of_birth
data.spec: Current value of the registration "Date of birth" date textbox, as an entered date string. Sent to RegisterAccount as date_of_birth.

data.name: gender
data.spec: Selected option of the registration "Gender" radiogroup: "Male", "Female", or empty string when nothing is selected. Sent to RegisterAccount as gender.

data.name: username
data.spec: Current text of the registration "Username" textbox. Sent to RegisterAccount as username.

data.name: password
data.spec: Current hidden text of the registration "Password" field. Sent to RegisterAccount as password.

data.name: confirm_password
data.spec: Current hidden text of the registration "Confirm Password" field; must match password before submission. Sent to RegisterAccount as confirm_password.

data.name: email
data.spec: Current text of the registration "Email address" textbox. Sent to RegisterAccount as email.

data.name: agreed_to_terms
data.spec: Whether the registration agreement checkbox is checked; must be true before submission. Sent to RegisterAccount as agreed_to_terms.

data.name: registration_error_message
data.spec: Error message describing invalid or duplicate registration input returned when submission fails; null when there is no error. Shown in the form error area and no account or session is created while it is set.

data.name: registration_submitting
data.spec: True while the registration submission is in flight after "Next step" is clicked; used to reflect the submitting state of the button until the request resolves.

handlers.name: LoadSessionState
handlers.spec: {a visitor opens the home page at /, authenticated or not} requests GET /api/session, passing no session id when the browser holds no session cookie and otherwise the current session cookie value {on a response with authenticated=true, stores session_state = {authenticated:true, username:<response.username>} so the header account area renders the saved username as text plus the Sign out link instead of Register and Login; on a response with authenticated=false, stores session_state = {authenticated:false, username:null} so the header renders the Register link pointing to /register and the Login link pointing to /login; if the request fails, session_state retains its initial unauthenticated value {authenticated:false, username:null}} {writes only session_state; creates or clears no session and changes no account data}

handlers.name: SignOutAccount
handlers.spec: {the header currently shows the signed-in account area with the saved username text and the Sign out link} activating Sign out sends DELETE /api/session carrying the current session cookie so the server deletes the persisted session and clears the cookie {on success stores session_state = {authenticated:false, username:null}, so the header account area restores the Register link pointing to /register and the Login link pointing to /login and the username text and Sign out link are no longer shown; the visitor stays on the home page} {if the request fails, session_state is left unchanged so the signed-in header remains visible} {the account row and its saved username are preserved; no new session is created}

handlers.name: NavigateToRegister
handlers.spec: {the header account area shows the guest state with the Register link} activating the Register link navigates the visitor to /register {the registration page is opened; no session or account data is written}

handlers.name: NavigateToLogin
handlers.spec: {the header account area shows the guest state with the Login link} activating the Login link navigates the visitor to /login {the login page is opened; no session or account data is written}

handlers.name: NavigateToHome
handlers.spec: {the registration page breadcrumb shows "Current location: HOME > Create an account"} activating the "HOME" link navigates the visitor to / {the home page is opened; no session or account data is written and the current authentication state is unchanged}

handlers.name: ChangeNationality
handlers.spec: {the registration form is displayed with the "Nationality" combobox showing "Please select"} the visitor picks an option such as "Vietnam" {nationality equals the selected option value; no API calls and no validation error is produced at this point}

handlers.name: ChangeName
handlers.spec: {the registration "Name" textbox is displayed empty} the visitor types a name {name equals the entered text; no API calls}

handlers.name: ChangePassportNumber
handlers.spec: {the registration "Passport number" textbox is displayed empty} the visitor types a passport number {passport_number equals the entered text; no API calls}

handlers.name: ChangePassportExpirationDate
handlers.spec: {the registration "Passport expiration date" textbox is displayed empty} the visitor types or picks a date, either directly in the textbox or through the "Choose passport expiration date" calendar button {passport_expiration_date equals the entered date string; no API calls}

handlers.name: ChangeDateOfBirth
handlers.spec: {the registration "Date of birth" textbox is displayed empty} the visitor types or picks a date, either directly in the textbox or through the "Choose date of birth" calendar button {date_of_birth equals the entered date string; no API calls}

handlers.name: ChangeGender
handlers.spec: {the "Gender" radiogroup is displayed with neither "Male" nor "Female" selected} the visitor selects "Male" or "Female" {gender equals the selected radio option's label ("Male" or "Female"); no API calls}

handlers.name: ChangeUsername
handlers.spec: {the registration "Username" textbox is displayed empty} the visitor types a username {username equals the entered text; no API calls and uniqueness is only checked on submission}

handlers.name: ChangePassword
handlers.spec: {the registration "Password" field is displayed empty with hidden input content} the visitor types a password {password equals the entered hidden text; no API calls}

handlers.name: ChangeConfirmPassword
handlers.spec: {the registration "Confirm Password" field is displayed empty with hidden input content} the visitor types the confirmation password {confirm_password equals the entered hidden text; no API calls and the match with password is evaluated on submission}

handlers.name: ChangeEmailAddress
handlers.spec: {the registration "Email address" textbox is displayed empty} the visitor types an email address {email equals the entered text; no API calls and format or uniqueness is only checked on submission}

handlers.name: ChangeTermsAgreement
handlers.spec: {the agreement checkbox labeled "I have read and agree to abide by Terms of Service and Privacy Policy of 12306.cn." is displayed unchecked} the visitor checks or unchecks the checkbox {agreed_to_terms equals the checkbox checked state; no API calls}

handlers.name: SubmitRegistration
handlers.spec: {the visitor has entered the registration fields and clicks the "Next step" button while no submission is in flight} clears any previous error (registration_error_message = null), sets registration_submitting = true, and calls POST /api/register with the body built from the current form state: nationality, name, passport_number, passport_expiration_date, date_of_birth, gender, username, password, confirm_password, email and agreed_to_terms (true only when the consent checkbox is checked). All requirement validations (required fields, 2-100 non-whitespace characters for name, 6-30 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens for passport_number, date_of_birth earlier than today, passport_expiration_date later than today, 3-32 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens/underscores for username, valid email of at most 254 characters, 12-128 character password containing uppercase, lowercase, digit and special character, identical confirm_password, unique username and case-insensitively unique email) are enforced by the RegisterAccount API, so the handler does not bypass them. {on a response carrying an error} sets registration_submitting = false and sets registration_error_message to the returned error text, keeping the visitor on /register with the entered values and creating no account or session. {on a response carrying username} the API has already persisted the account and session and set the session cookie, so sets registration_submitting = false and navigates the visitor to / where the header load resolves the session and displays the saved username as text with the "Sign out" link} {a successful submission leaves registration_error_message null; a failed submission leaves the form data, account and session state otherwise unchanged}
